en.name: Lyney&Lynette
en.ability: Each night*, you may choose two living players; abilities that affect one of them affect the other instead. Each player can only be chosen once per game.

revisions.v1: Each night*, you may choose two living players; abilities that affect one of them affect the other instead. Each player can only be chosen once per game.

en.flavor: With a flick of the wrist, a sleight of hand, a flash of misdirection—the magician weaves a spell of wonder and delight. What is this beguiling art, this dance of the fingers?
